import json
from fractions import Fraction as F

# Coefficients of the three given vectors in the basis (a, b, c).
v1 = [F(1), F(-2), F(3)]    # a - 2b + 3c
v2 = [F(2), F(3), F(-4)]    # 2a + 3b - 4c

# Collinearity of the three vectors as points means v3 = v1 + t*(v2 - v1)
# for some scalar t. The vector v3 = p*b + q*c has zero a-coefficient,
# which fixes t.
d = [v2[i] - v1[i] for i in range(3)]
assert d[0] != 0
t = -v1[0] / d[0]

# Read off p and q from the b and c coefficients, and check the a-coefficient vanishes.
w = [v1[i] + t * d[i] for i in range(3)]
assert w[0] == 0
p, q = w[1], w[2]

# Independent check: 2*v1 - v2 - v3 = 0 with coefficients summing to zero.
v3 = [F(0), p, q]
residual = [2 * v1[i] - v2[i] - v3[i] for i in range(3)]
assert all(r == 0 for r in residual)
assert 2 - 1 - 1 == 0

result = {
    "final_answer": f"({p},{q})",
    "evidence": {
        "t": str(t),
        "p": str(p),
        "q": str(q),
        "relation": "v3 = 2*v1 - v2",
        "residual": [str(r) for r in residual],
    },
}
print(json.dumps(result))
